items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.summary: Crit chance and a large bonus to crit damage. The first item for any crit carry.

items.name: Blade of Despair
items.summary: The largest flat physical attack in the game, and more damage to low-HP targets.

items.name: Endless Battle
items.summary: True damage after using a skill, plus lifesteal and mana. Best on heroes that weave skills into basic attacks.

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.summary: Lifesteal that scales up sharply at low HP. Wins duels you should have lost.

items.name: Windtalker
items.summary: Attack speed, movement speed, and a periodic area attack that clears waves fast.

items.name: Golden Staff
items.summary: Converts crit chance into extra hits. The core item for on-hit marksmen instead of crit.

items.name: Demon Hunter Sword
items.summary: Basic attacks deal a share of the target's current HP — the answer to enemy tanks.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.summary: Percentage physical penetration. Buy it when they stack armour, not before.

items.name: Hunter Strike
items.summary: Penetration plus a burst of movement speed after hitting a hero — closes gaps for assassins.

items.name: Great Dragon Spear
items.summary: Cooldown reduction with an active dash. Turns a fighter into a repeat diver.

items.name: Rose Gold Meteor
items.summary: Magic resist and a shield at low HP. The physical carry's answer to enemy mage burst.

items.name: Sea Halberd
items.summary: Cuts the healing on whoever you hit. The physical side's anti-heal.

items.name: Corrosion Scythe
items.summary: Basic attacks slow the target and stack attack speed. Good into melee divers.

items.name: Blade of the Heptaseas
items.summary: A large bonus hit when you break stealth or come from out of vision — assassin burst.

items.name: War Axe
items.summary: Stacks attack and penetration the longer you fight. Rewards staying in the fight.

items.name: Queen's Wings
items.summary: Reduces damage taken and boosts your damage while below half HP. Anti-burst for bruisers.

items.name: Wind of Nature
items.summary: Active grants immunity to physical damage for a few seconds — survives a marksman focus.

items.name: Thunder Belt
items.summary: Defence with percent-HP damage attached to your basic attacks after a skill.

items.name: Clock of Destiny
items.summary: Stacks HP and magic power over time. The safe first item on a mage that wants to survive.

items.name: Lightning Truncheon
items.summary: Every third skill fires extra area damage. Core on any mage with a fast rotation.

items.name: Holy Crystal
items.summary: The largest magic power in the game. Buy it when you already survive long enough to cast.

items.name: Divine Glaive
items.summary: Percentage magic penetration — the answer once they buy magic resist.

items.name: Genius Wand
items.summary: Your magic damage shreds the target's magic defence as you keep hitting them.

items.name: Blood Wings
items.summary: Huge magic power that also converts into a shield. The standard late-game mage item.

items.name: Concentrated Energy
items.summary: Spell vamp and HP — lets a mage trade in fights instead of only poking.

items.name: Ice Queen Wand
items.summary: Your damage slows the target. Strong on mages with damage over time or area zones.

items.name: Enchanted Talisman
items.summary: Cooldown reduction and mana regeneration. Fixes any mage that runs out of resources.

items.name: Fleeting Time
items.summary: A kill or assist cuts your ultimate's cooldown. Best on heroes whose ultimate wins fights.

items.name: Necklace of Durance
items.summary: Your magic damage cuts the target's healing. The magic side's anti-heal.

items.name: Glowing Wand
items.summary: Burns a share of the target's max HP over time — magic damage that scales into tanks.

items.name: Winter Crown
items.summary: Active freezes you: immune to damage and control for a moment. Escapes suppression and burst chains.

items.name: Feather of Heaven
items.summary: Magic power on attack speed — for hybrid heroes who deal magic damage with basic attacks.

items.name: Starlium Scythe
items.summary: Magic power with a shield on skill use — survivability without giving up damage.

items.name: Antique Cuirass
items.summary: Each hit taken lowers that enemy's physical attack. The default answer to physical comps.

items.name: Blade Armor
items.summary: Reflects physical damage and blunts crits. Buy it against a fed marksman or assassin.

items.name: Dominance Ice
items.summary: Slows enemy attack speed and weakens their lifesteal and shields. Tank-slot anti-sustain.

items.name: Athena's Shield
items.summary: Magic resist plus a recurring shield. The frontline answer to repeated mage burst.

items.name: Oracle
items.summary: Magic resist that also amplifies the healing and shields you receive. Core on supports.

items.name: Radiant Armor
items.summary: Stacking magic damage reduction. The cheapest way to blunt a magic-heavy enemy team.

items.name: Immortality
items.summary: Revives you once with a shield. Buy it when they have a pick-off threat that will find you.

items.name: Brute Force Breastplate
items.summary: Stacks movement speed and resistances as you fight, and shortens crowd control on you.

items.name: Cursed Helmet
items.summary: Burns nearby enemies for a share of their max HP. Tank damage that scales into other tanks.

items.name: Guardian Helmet
items.summary: A very large HP pool with out-of-combat regeneration — lets a roamer stay on the map.

items.name: Warrior Boots
items.summary: Physical defence that stacks as you take hits. Default boots against a physical lane.

items.name: Magic Shoes
items.summary: Cooldown reduction. Default boots for mages, assassins and anyone skill-reliant.

items.name: Tough Boots
items.summary: Magic defence and shorter crowd control on you. Mandatory against heavy CC drafts.

items.name: Swift Boots
items.summary: Attack speed. Default boots for basic-attack carries when the enemy has little CC.

items.name: Rapid Boots
items.summary: The most raw movement speed — for roamers who need to be in three places.

items.name: Demon Shoes
items.summary: Mana regeneration for heroes who cannot hold their rotation without it.

items.name: Arcane Boots
items.summary: Flat magic penetration — more early damage than Magic Shoes if you are already ahead.

items.name: Purify
items.summary: Removes all control effects and grants brief immunity. On a carry this is worth more than Flicker.

items.name: Flicker
items.summary: Short-range teleport. The default escape, and an engage tool on tanks.

items.name: Execute
items.summary: Finishing damage based on the target's missing HP — secures kills your burst just misses.

items.name: Retribution
items.summary: Jungle damage and objective steal. Mandatory on the jungler, useless on anyone else.
